info.name: Baserow API spec Admin Workspace invitations API

params.name: workspace_invitation_id
params.description: Returns the workspace invitation related to the provided value.

items.docs: Returns the requested workspace invitation if the authorized user has admin right to the related workspace

params.name: workspace_invitation_id
params.description: Updates the workspace invitation related to the provided value.

items.docs: Updates the existing workspace invitation related to the provided `workspace_invitation_id` param if the authorized user has admin rights to the related workspace.

params.name: workspace_invitation_id
params.description: Deletes the workspace invitation related to the provided value.

items.docs: Deletes a workspace invitation if the authorized user has admin rights to the related workspace.

params.name: workspace_invitation_id
params.description: Accepts the workspace invitation related to the provided value.

items.docs: Accepts a workspace invitation with the given id if the email address of the user matches that of the invitation.

params.name: workspace_invitation_id
params.description: Rejects the workspace invitation related to the provided value.

items.docs: Rejects a workspace invitation with the given id if the email address of the user matches that of the invitation.

params.name: token
params.description: Returns the workspace invitation related to the provided token.

items.docs: Responds with the serialized workspace invitation if an invitation with the provided token is found.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Returns only invitations that are in the workspace related to the provided value.

items.docs: Lists all the workspace invitations of the workspace related to the provided `workspace_id` parameter if the authorized user has admin rights to that workspace.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Creates a workspace invitation to the workspace related to the provided value.

items.docs: Creates a new workspace invitations for an email address if the authorized user has admin rights to the related workspace. An email containing a sign up link will be send to the user.
